findings.statement: Nwando Achebe is the author of the book The Female King of Colonial Nigeria, which is recorded with date 2011-02-21 and described as published in February 2011.

The book The Female King of Colonial Nigeria is about Ahebi Ugbabe, an Igbo woman who became king in colonial Nigeria, was exiled from Igboland, became a prostitute, traveled widely, and learned to speak many languages.
